0.0: Training can breed impatience, but you have to get tough to reach nirvana! Train until you drop, that's what I say.
0.1: I'm talking about all the #r#o2600315##k monsters in #b#MDmirrorD_324_2_##k. They got impatient and attempted a forbidden training method. It's appalling that they once used to train alongside the rest of us.
0.2: Once your greed starts to grow, you can never return. We can't let them just run wild. Could you help me out?

yes.0: Eliminate #r18 #o2600315##k monsters in #b#MDmirrorD_324_2_##k. They're hiding all over the place, so you might really have to dig for them.

no.0: Each one of them used to be my beloved student...

yes.0: Okay. I'm glad you were the one to get them. They probably wanted to be stopped, really...
